lines.speaker: Jules Kim
lines.text: I thought last sprint went well. The estimates were closer than usual, which was nice.

lines.speaker: Tam Osei
lines.text: Agreed. I think the difference was breaking things down before planning rather than during.

lines.speaker: Wren Alvarez
lines.text: That matches what I've seen elsewhere. Teams that estimate stories they've already discussed tend to be more accurate.

lines.speaker: Jules Kim
lines.text: There were a couple of small things that annoyed me but honestly they're not worth raising, I'll just handle them.

lines.speaker: Tam Osei
lines.text: Fair. How do people feel about the meeting length? Should we keep it at thirty minutes?

lines.speaker: Jules Kim
lines.text: Same. Alright, that's it — nothing to action, thanks everyone.
